replica_vintage_vs_abl580.question: A replica refresh ran during this heartbeat and the file changed size, so: were CH and ABL-580's three fitted on the same data? The ship set is deployed as one homogeneous batch.
replica_vintage_vs_abl580.verdict: No row in energy_generation or weather_data -- inside the fit window or anywhere -- was written after ABL-580's fit: both table maxima PRECEDE it (14:27:33 and 2026-08-26 15:00:54 against 14:53:09Z). The refresh rewrote pages without moving the vintage these fits read, so CH and ABL-580's three are on one data vintage and no refit of ABL-580's artifacts is implied. Note this is established by the maxima, not by the zero counts: the zero counts alone would also be produced by a cut placed past the end of the data.
